offering_description.value: Provides intermodal, truckload, brokerage, dedicated trucking and logistics services to shippers. Arranges and moves freight mainly by rail-based intermodal containers and trucks, using its own container fleet and tractors plus contracted rail and carrier capacity. Customers are large retailers, consumer goods and industrial shippers.

primary_services.value: intermodal container transport; truck brokerage; dedicated trucking; managed transportation and logistics; final-mile delivery and warehousing

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, consumer goods makers, manufacturers and other shippers needing freight transport

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; manufacturing; food and beverage; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight transportation, brokerage and logistics services charged per shipment; project or contract: dedicated trucking and managed transportation under multi-year contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys rail, truck and drayage capacity and sells transport and logistics to shippers; asset operator: owns containers, chassis, tractors and trailers used in intermodal and dedicated services

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with cross-border services in Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: intermodal, truck brokerage, dedicated trucking, managed transportation and final-mile services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving shippers and national accounts; agents / brokers: third-party freight brokers and logistics intermediaries sell some services

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: trucking and freight brokerage subject to DOT, FMCSA safety and licensing rules, plus rail and environmental rules

notes: Final-mile and logistics detail is from general knowledge; the mix of business lines may have changed.
